stories.title: Cubs Shut Out Cardinals in Game 1 — Holmes, Suzuki Deliver
stories.angle: Clay Holmes dominated in Game 1 at Wrigley on Friday. Seiya Suzuki broke it open with a three-run HR in the 6th inning off Cardinals reliever George Soriano, Jacob Webb closed it out in the 9th. Cubs now 72-51, Cardinals fall to 61-61. No final score per has_score=False insight — lead with Holmes and Suzuki's performances.

Clay Holmes shut the door on St. Louis on Friday at Wrigley.

Seiya Suzuki's three-run shot in the sixth was all the Cubs needed. Webb closed it out in the ninth.

Boyd takes the hill at 1:20 PM CT. Cubs want this series.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Edward Cabrera Returns Sunday
stories.angle: Cabrera coming off the IL to start Game 3 Sunday at Wrigley, replacing Shota Imanaga's slot. Final rehab outing (Aug 11, Knoxville): 5 IP, 0 H, 7 K, 1 BB. With Horton and Miller lost for the year, this is a genuine rotation boost entering September.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Edward Cabrera is back.

Five hitless innings, seven strikeouts in his final rehab start at Knoxville.

He replaces Imanaga in Sunday's slot — Game 3 at Wrigley vs the Cardinals. With Horton and Miller out for the year, the rotation needed this.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB

stories.title: Ben Cowles Powers Iowa — Prospect Pipeline Update
stories.angle: Ben Cowles hit two HRs and drove in four runs for Iowa in a 10-3 rout of St. Paul on Aug 14. Palencia rehabbing. Cabrera already back. System keeps producing despite the major league injury toll.

Palencia is rehabbing. Cabrera's back up. The pipeline doesn't stop.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #GoCubs
